name: cx-rules-only~p1
task: Never pick up the box in the other room. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed, and whenever you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Absence(target_picked_up) is hard for the unconditional 'Never pick up the box'; Absence(key_lost) is soft for 'Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed', and key_lost matches that event exactly; Response(has_door_key, door_open) is soft for 'whenever you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it later', with the same-step-or-later timing. No clause adds a requirement, and the task has no hard goal, so the rule-only warning and empty FINAL_STATES are valid.
